verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's docs keep a News/updates changelog (api-docs.deepseek.com/updates) that records both API changes, such as native support for the OpenAI Responses API format, and model changes, such as the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp and V4.1 Flash launches. It also posts dated lifecycle notices, like the three-month deprecation of deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner (2026-07-24) with an explanation of which modes those names currently map to. Missing for 10: any evidenced way to subscribe to updates (RSS, email or API notifications), and independent or community corroboration that the changelog is kept complete and timely.
